_description: Exact lexicons for the quantitative register pass (ANALYTIC_BRIEF.md §7). Edit here, not in code. Every figure in every essay is regenerable by running tagging/count.py over the /transcripts files with these lists. Counts are crude regex passes over ASR text: directional evidence, not ground truth. ALWAYS report raw counts alongside rates so small-n fragility is visible (a dissociation from a 12-word lexicon on one episode is suggestive, not a result), and hand-check a sample before resting a claim on any count — see H3's demotion in essay 03 for why.
_regex_flags: case-insensitive; matched as whole-word alternations with \b boundaries except where a token contains internal punctuation

hedges.gloss: epistemic hedge tokens (H2), faithful to ANALYTIC_BRIEF.md §7's exact list. NOTE: 'kind of'/'sort of' as degree adverbs inflate this; hand-check before quoting magnitude. Deliberately EXCLUDES 'I mean'/'probably'/'I suppose' (discourse markers / not in the brief's list) — including them roughly doubles BC's count, which is itself evidence the magnitude is lexicon-fragile.

profanity.gloss: profanity per 1k words + function (KJB structural/connective vs BC punctuational) — function is hand-coded, not captured here.

apology.gloss: apology tokens (BC apology subroutine vs KJB mock-apology vs — essay 03 — KJB genuine repair under live format). Hand-check sincere vs mock.

first_person_singular.gloss: 1sg rate (H6/H13 proxy). FREQUENCY is topic-driven and pair-variable (Casino Royale inverts); only FUNCTION is stable. Count function, not this number, for H13.

disgust.gloss: disgust/avoidance lexicon (H3). DEMOTED essay 03: lexical dissociation is pair-variable (depends on desire/body content + format). Treat as functional claim backed by hand-coded samples, not as a count. EXCLUDES 'creepy'/'cringe' (descriptive, not recoil-at-the-object): including them lifts KJB's Casino Royale count 8->? and erodes the dissociation, a worked example of why this rides on hand-coded function not raw lexicon.

anger.gloss: anger/contempt lexicon (H3). Same demotion caveat as disgust.

ad_strip.gloss: BC iHeart ad reads are dynamically inserted at SCRAPE time (e.g. 2024 ads in a 2018 episode) — they reflect scrape date, not air date. Strip from register counts; cite separately as monetisation-architecture evidence. KJB has no ads (listener-funded). Stripping removes whole sentences matched by these campaign-marker regexes.
